# ArDrive

> ArDrive provides permanent, decentralized storage powered by Arweave. This file maps the public site and help center for AI agents and retrieval tools.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://ardrive.io/): Pay once. Store forever.
- [About](https://ardrive.io/about/): What ArDrive is and who builds it.
- [Pricing](https://ardrive.io/pricing/): Estimate permanent storage costs.
- [Developers](https://ardrive.io/developers/): Developer resources for building with ArDrive.
- [Enterprise](https://ardrive.io/enterprise/): Permanent storage for organizations.
- [Articles](https://ardrive.io/articles/): Guides and announcements.
- [Help](https://ardrive.io/help/): Product guides, FAQs, and troubleshooting.
- [Contact](https://ardrive.io/contact/): Contact ArDrive support.
- [Brand Kit](https://ardrive.io/brand-kit/): Logos, colors and typography.

## Brand and Design

- [Brand kit JSON](https://ardrive.io/brand-kit/agents.json): Machine-readable logos, colors, typography and copy terms.
- [Design system](https://ardrive.io/brand-kit/design-system.md): The standard for ArDrive app UI: theme tokens, type scale, spacing, components and copy rules.

## Machine-Readable Help

- [Full help corpus](https://ardrive.io/llms-full.txt): All public help article bodies in markdown-oriented text.
- [Help JSON index](https://ardrive.io/help/index.json): Structured help article metadata.

## ArDrive as a Platform

### ArDrive Platform

- [ArDrive CLI](https://ardrive.io/help/ardrive-as-a-platform-ardrive-platform-ardrive-cli/): Use the ArDrive CLI for terminal-based ArDrive workflows.
- [ArDrive Core](https://ardrive.io/help/ardrive-as-a-platform-ardrive-platform-ardrive-core/): ArDrive Core contains the essential back end features for the ArDrive apps, written in TypeScript. While the Arweave network gives the power of.

### Arweave File System

- [Arweave File System](https://ardrive.io/help/ardrive-as-a-platform-arweave-file-system-arweave-file-system/): Technical overview of ArFS, the Arweave File System used by ArDrive.
- [Drive Entity](https://ardrive.io/help/ardrive-as-a-platform-arweave-file-system-drive-entity/): Technical overview of the ArFS Drive entity and root folder relationship.
- [Move File](https://ardrive.io/help/ardrive-as-a-platform-arweave-file-system-move-file/): Technical overview of how ArFS represents moving files within a Drive.
- [Move Folder](https://ardrive.io/help/ardrive-as-a-platform-arweave-file-system-move-folder/): Technical overview of how ArFS represents moving folders within a Drive.
- [Rename Drive](https://ardrive.io/help/ardrive-as-a-platform-arweave-file-system-rename-drive/): Technical overview of how ArFS represents Drive renames.
- [Rename File](https://ardrive.io/help/ardrive-as-a-platform-arweave-file-system-rename-file/): Technical overview of how ArFS represents file renames.
- [Rename Folder](https://ardrive.io/help/ardrive-as-a-platform-arweave-file-system-rename-folder/): Technical overview of how ArFS represents folder renames.
- [Schema Diagrams](https://ardrive.io/help/ardrive-as-a-platform-arweave-file-system-schema-diagrams/): Technical diagrams for public and private ArFS Drive structures.
- [Update File Version](https://ardrive.io/help/ardrive-as-a-platform-arweave-file-system-update-file-version/): Technical overview of how ArFS represents new file versions.

## FAQs

### FAQ

- [ArDrive On The Permaweb](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-faq-ardrive-on-the-permaweb-dapp/): Use the permanent ArDrive dApp entry point on the permaweb.
- [ArDrive Turbo](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-faq-ardrive-turbo/): Common questions about ArDrive Turbo Credits, payments, receipts, refunds, and support.
- [Arweave Wallets](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-faq-arweave-wallets/): Common questions about Arweave wallets, recovery phrases, and logging in to ArDrive.
- [Everything You Need To Know About ArDrive](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-faq-everything-you-need-to-know-about-ardrive/): Common questions about permanence, privacy, uploads, sharing, and permaweb URLs in ArDrive.
- [How Do Turbo Conversions Work](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-faq-how-do-turbo-conversions-work/): Understand how Turbo upload prices are estimated from file size, AR, and Credits.
- [How keyfile and recovery phrase login work](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-faq-how-do-keyfile-and-seed-phrase-login-work/): Learn how keyfile, recovery phrase, and wallet sign-in work in ArDrive and how to protect wallet access.
- [What Are The Privacy And Encryption Standards?](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-faq-what-are-the-privacy-and-encryption-standards/): Private Drive files are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, while public files remain public forever.
- [What Currencies Or Cryptocurrencies Can I Use To Upload?](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-faq-what-currencies-or-cryptocurrencies-can-i-use-to-upload/): ArDrive supports permanent storage payments through Turbo Credits or AR tokens.
- [What Makes ArDrive Different From Other File Storage Apps](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-faq-what-makes-ardrive-different-from-other-file-storage-apps/): What makes ArDrive different from other file storage apps?
- [Where Can I Make A Feature Request](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-faq-where-can-i-make-a-feature-request/): Where can I make a feature request?
- [Which languages does ArDrive support?](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-faq-which-languages-does-ardrive-support/): ArDrive shows its text in English, Spanish, Hindi, Japanese, and Chinese. It follows the language of your browser.

### Help And Troubleshooting Guides

- [ArDrive App Limits](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-help-and-troubleshooting-guides-ardrive-app-limits/): Current upload and download limits for ArDrive by upload method, platform, and browser.
- [Bad Gateway And Network Errors](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-help-and-troubleshooting-guides-bad-gateway-and-network-errors/): Troubleshoot 502, 503, 504, bad gateway, network, resource, ar.io, GraphQL, gateway, and frontend errors in ArDrive Web.
- [Cannot Access Or Retrieve A File](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-help-and-troubleshooting-guides-cannot-access-or-retrieve-file/): If a file will not load, preview, download, access, or retrieve from ArDrive Web and you see 502, 503, 504, bad gateway, network, resource, ar.io, or gateway errors, the issue may be temporary gateway availability.
- [Change Gateway URL For ArDrive](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-help-and-troubleshooting-guides-change-gateway-url-for-ardrive/): Advanced users can change the gateway, GraphQL server, and Turbo services that ArDrive uses, in Settings or on the login screen.
- [Check Browser Console Logs](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-help-and-troubleshooting-guides-check-browser-console-logs/): Browser console logs and network errors are the best way to understand ArDrive Web issues and help support troubleshoot login, gateway, upload, download, preview, or sync problems.
- [Clearing Your Cache](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-help-and-troubleshooting-guides-clearing-your-cache/): Clear browser cache for app.ardrive.io when files, folders, drives, or statuses look stale.
- [Drive Syncing Issues](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-help-and-troubleshooting-guides-drive-syncing-issues/): Drive syncing issues are usually caused by intermittent gateway indexing delays and often resolve on their own within a few hours.
- [File Upload Issues And Workarounds](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-help-and-troubleshooting-guides-file-upload-issues-and-workarounds/): Troubleshoot file upload status, gateway indexing delays, and transaction visibility.
- [Login Trouble](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-help-and-troubleshooting-guides-login-trouble/): Troubleshoot ArDrive Web login issues, including password, keyfile, recovery phrase, wallet, locked drive, browser, and gateway-related login errors.
- [Sync Your Drive](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-help-and-troubleshooting-guides-sync-your-drive/): Use Sync or Full resync when files show red or orange status, recently uploaded files don't appear, or your drive looks stale.
- [Trouble Accessing Data Through arweave.net?](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-help-and-troubleshooting-guides-trouble-accessing-data-through-arweave-net/): Check whether a transaction or data item loads on other public Arweave gateways, and find out who to contact.
- [Turbo Gateway Rate Limits](https://ardrive.io/help/faqs-help-and-troubleshooting-guides-turbo-gateway-rate-limits/): Free download allowances, refill rates, and paid upgrades for data access through turbo-gateway.com.

## Understanding The Permaweb

- [Arweave Manifests](https://ardrive.io/help/understanding-the-permaweb-general-arweave-manifests/): Learn how Arweave Manifests map transaction IDs to friendly file names and paths.
- [Block Explorers](https://ardrive.io/help/understanding-the-permaweb-general-block-explorers/): Use ViewBlock or ArScan to check a wallet's transaction history and confirm whether an upload reached Arweave.
- [What Is The Permaweb](https://ardrive.io/help/understanding-the-permaweb-general-what-is-the-permaweb/): Learn what the permaweb is and how Arweave stores data permanently.

## Using ArDrive Apps

### Actions

- [Actions](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-actions-actions/): Find the actions for drives, folders, and files in one menu for each.
- [ArDrive Explorer View](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-actions-ardrive-explorer-view/): Where to find the actions for your drives, folders, and files in ArDrive.
- [Download A File](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-actions-download-a-file/): Download files from ArDrive. Downloading costs nothing.
- [Drive Explorer](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-actions-drive-explorer/): Find your way around Your drives and the file list: the sidebar, the menus, and how a click works.
- [Drive Sharing](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-actions-drive-sharing/): Share a public or private drive, or a folder, with a link. A private drive also needs its access key.
- [Export Csv Table](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-actions-export-csv-table/): Export a CSV inventory of Drive contents, transaction IDs, links, and metadata.
- [File Sharing](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-actions-file-sharing/): Share a public or private file with a link. A private file also needs its access key.
- [Hiding Files From Your Drive](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-actions-hiding-files-from-your-drive/): Hide a file, a folder, or a drive from your view, show hidden items, and unhide them.
- [Licensing Your Data](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-actions-licensing-your-data/): Add a license to a file to say how others can use it, and see what it costs.
- [Move A File Or Folder](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-actions-move-a-file-or-folder/): Move files or folders to another folder in the same drive.
- [New File Versions](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-actions-new-file-versions/): Upload a replacement file with the same name to create a new file version.
- [Public Preview](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-actions-public-preview/): Open a file in a public drive at its web address.
- [Rename A File Or Folder](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-actions-rename-a-file-or-folder/): Rename files, folders, and drives in ArDrive and keep their data history.
- [Storing Your NFT Data With ArDrive Web](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-actions-storing-your-nft-data-with-ardrive-web/): Store NFT assets and metadata permanently with ArDrive.

### Getting Started

- [Fund your wallet](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-getting-started-fund-your-wallet/): Pay for ArDrive uploads with Turbo Credits, by card or crypto, or with AR tokens.
- [Log into ArDrive with a keyfile](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-getting-started-log-into-ardrive-keyfile/): Log in to ArDrive with your Arweave wallet keyfile and your password.
- [Log into ArDrive with a recovery phrase](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-getting-started-log-into-ardrive-seed-phrase/): Log in to ArDrive with your 12-word recovery phrase and your password.
- [Log into ArDrive with MetaMask](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-getting-started-log-into-ardrive-metamask-wallet/): Sign in to ArDrive with MetaMask. ArDrive makes an Arweave wallet from your MetaMask signature, so there is no keyfile to manage.
- [Log into ArDrive with Phantom or Solflare](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-getting-started-log-into-ardrive-phantom-or-solflare/): Use the Phantom or Solflare browser wallet to sign in to ArDrive with a wallet approval, with no sign-in password.
- [Log into ArDrive with Wander](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-getting-started-log-into-ardrive-arconnect/): Use the Wander browser extension to sign in to ArDrive with a wallet approval, with no ArDrive password.
- [Sign up for ArDrive](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-getting-started-create-an-arweave-wallet-with-ardrive/): Create an ArDrive account with a password and a recovery phrase.
- [Your drive password](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-getting-started-ardrive-password/): One password protects all your private drives. Learn which password you use, how to unlock a locked drive, and how Remember on this device works.

### Using ArDrive

- [Account and security](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-using-ardrive-account-and-security/): See how you sign in, download your keyfile, forget remembered drives, and copy your addresses.
- [Add Turbo Credits and use Billing](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-using-ardrive-add-turbo-credits-and-billing/): Add Turbo Credits from the upload review or the Billing page, and see how the free upload allowance works.
- [Attach A Drive](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-using-ardrive-attach-a-drive/): Attach a drive that someone shared with you, using its drive ID, so it shows in your Shared with me list.
- [Create A Deployment (Arweave Manifest)](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-using-ardrive-create-an-arweave-manifest/): Create a deployment from a public drive or folder to give its files friendly paths at one Arweave address.
- [Create a drive](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-using-ardrive-create-new-drive/): Create a public or private drive for permanent file storage.
- [Create A Snapshot](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-using-ardrive-create-a-snapshot/): Create Drive snapshots to speed up future syncing for large public or private Drives.
- [Names](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-using-ardrive-names/): Point an ArNS name you own at a published page, a deployment, or a public file, and pay for the change with Turbo Credits.
- [New Folders](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-using-ardrive-new-folders/): Create folders to organize files inside an ArDrive drive.
- [Open a drive without signing in](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-using-ardrive-open-a-drive-without-signing-in/): Open a public drive from a link or a drive ID, with no account. A private drive also needs the key it was shared with.
- [Pin a file](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-using-ardrive-pin-a-file/): Add a file that is already on Arweave to your drive by its transaction ID, without uploading it again.
- [Publish to web](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-using-ardrive-publish-to-web/): Turn a public drive, a folder, or a file into a web page, update it, and find it again in Web pages.
- [Share Turbo Credits](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-using-ardrive-share-turbo-credits/): See the credits shared with you and the credits you shared, and use credits held on a Solana wallet.
- [The New Button](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-using-ardrive-the-new-button/): Use New to upload files, make folders, notes, pins, and drives, attach a shared drive, and create deployments or snapshots.
- [Uploading Files](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-using-ardrive-uploading-files/): Upload files to a drive, review the one-time storage price, and wait for upload confirmation.
- [Web pages](https://ardrive.io/help/using-ardrive-apps-using-ardrive-web-pages/): Find every page you published, open it, copy its link, update it, and give it a name.
